Launching a company can feel like a mountain of decisions. The trick is picking tools that work well together so you don't waste time on setup.

One Bundle, Zero Headaches

The Founder Bundle combines a website, branding assets, and automation templates. Everything plays nicely so you can focus on your offer.

Weekend Launch Plan

  1. Friday night: Choose a template and add your copy
  2. Saturday morning: Connect your domain and set up automations
  3. Sunday: Announce your new business with ready-made social posts

Grow From Day One

Because the bundle includes our AI Writer, you can start publishing content immediately to attract your first customers.

You've Got This

Skip the endless tool research. With the Founder Bundle, you're ready to launch in a single weekend.
